tagline.zh: 近战前排：武器与狂怒输出，或防护系承担坦克。
tagline.en: Front-line melee: Arms and Fury damage, or Protection tanking.

strengths.zh: 生存力强，能切坦克职责，组队需求高。
strengths.en: Durable, can tank, always in demand for groups.

drawbacks.zh: 依赖装备与怒气循环，练级偏慢。
drawbacks.en: Gear- and rage-dependent; slower to level.

provenance.notes: Class list and roles per Blizzard class deep-dive posts; tree data extracted from beta client.
